title: Post a job
summary: Tell providers what you need, step by step.

steps.headline: Start a new job
steps.body: On your Home screen, tap Post a job to begin.
steps.narration: To start, tap Post a job on your Home screen.

steps.headline: Choose a service
steps.body: Pick the kind of work you need, like plumbing or cleaning.
steps.narration: Next, choose the service you need, like plumbing or cleaning.

steps.headline: Describe the work
steps.body: Add the location and a few details so providers know what to expect.
steps.narration: Then describe the work and add your location, so providers know what to expect.

steps.headline: Pick a time
steps.body: Choose when you would like the work done.
steps.narration: After that, pick when you would like the work done.

steps.headline: Review and post
steps.body: Check everything once more, then tap Post job.
steps.narration: Finally, review everything and tap post job. Nearby providers will see it right away.
